name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – § 25 – Am 24
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 25. Expresses concern about the Commission’s announcement that it will put bilateral support on hold and partially suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement; encourages continued relations in all fields between the EU, the Member States and Israel, in line with the association agreement;
